action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (slope agreement 0.73) with weak seasonality (0.16) and unstable model rankings (Kendall tau 0.267). The 14 tree-based models form one highly correlated error group, so adding more models or fitting weights adds noise rather than signal. A simple mean over the 7 most consistently-ranked models (pool2) is the most robust choice: it benefits from diversity within the stable subset without overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows. The 'separated' verdict confirms it is statistically superior to the runner-up.
